description:
A collaboration between mobile game Monster Strike x Love Live! Sunshine!!: A music video for the song KU-RU-KU-RU Cruller! by Aqours. In the music video, "Aqours" is sporting their costumes seen in the Monster Strike collaboration event while performing to the danceable taste and sound of the 80's.

Note: The trailer is only a short preview. The full animation is included with the KU-RU-KU-RU Cruller! single Blu-ray/DVD set.
